name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: Either Dough goes with Spoon or Gus goes with Wobbler.
Popper, Wobbler, and Nightcrawler go with Boone, Mabel, and Royce, in some order.
Exactly one of these is true: Boone goes with Popper; Spoon goes with Leech; Swimbait goes with Corn.
Between Buzzbait and Popper, one goes with Mabel and the other with Corn.
Either Leech goes with Wade or Spoon goes with Royce.
